evidence.extracted_text:
Alex Reed: I am interested in Flat 2, 20 Example Mews, London W12 8QT. Can I view it on 15 November 2026 at 16:00 before paying?
Rowan Pike: The owner Mira Vale is abroad. You cannot view until you pay. Buy GBP 1500 in prepaid gift cards and send the redemption codes by 16 November 2026 at 18:00, or I will give the room to someone else.
Alex Reed: The contract names Mira Vale and lists you, Rowan Pike, as the managing agent. Why are gift cards needed?
Rowan Pike: The codes are our reservation system. There is no bank transfer alternative and no viewing before the codes arrive.

Tenancy agreement
Property: Flat 2, 20 Example Mews, London W12 8QT
Landlord: Mira Vale
Letting representative: Rowan Pike, acting for Northbank Example Lettings Ltd.
Rent: GBP 1300 per calendar month.
Tenancy deposit: GBP 1500.
The tenancy is periodic from 1 December 2026.
The tenant may end the tenancy with two months' written notice.
No administration fee is payable.
The landlord is responsible for structural and heating repairs, except tenant-caused damage.
